message.content:
I'll search for the definition of "monogamous" for you.

<tool>web_search</tool>
<query>monogamous definition meaning</query>

Based on my search, **monogamous** is an adjective with two main meanings:

1. **In a romantic/sexual context**: Having a sexual relationship with only one partner at a time; practicing or advocating for exclusive romantic commitment to one person. This is the most common modern usage.

2. **In biology/zoology**: Having only one mate at a time or (in some species) for life. Many animals are described as monogamous if they form exclusive pair bonds for breeding.

The word comes from the Greek roots *mono-* (one, single) and *gamos* (marriage). 

The noun form is **monogamy**, and a person who practices it is sometimes called a **monogamist**. The opposite terms are **polygamous/polygamy** (having multiple partners/spouses) or **non-monogamous**.

In common conversation, if someone says "I'm monogamous," they typically mean they are committed to being sexually and romantically exclusive with one person.

Sources:
1. https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/monogamous
2. https://www.dictionary.com/browse/monogamous
3. https://www.oed.com/search/dictionary/?scope=Entries&q=monogamous
